title: 2-to-1 games with perfect completeness
description: Projection games, their value and their repetition; formulas with a gap; the clause-variable game and the base game with perfect completeness and small soundness, from two named hypotheses. Slices of matrices over the field with two elements and the inverse theorem for partial tables, from a third named hypothesis. The tree of function spaces, keys of functions, the constraints of the new game, perfect completeness. Joint folding, the functional of a response, buckets, and the law of the tests. The course is the start of an exposition of OpenAI's proof (2026) of the 2-to-1 games conjecture with perfect completeness; the reduction to 2-to-1 games is not yet in the course.

units.title: Projection games and the base game
Matrices, slices and the inverse theorem
The tree of function spaces and the questions
Folding and the law of the tests

prerequisites: finite probability spaces; Boolean formulas in conjunctive normal form; the notion of a map computable in polynomial time
